input.question: Who is the artist of the "Classic Christmas" album?

documents.text: Classic Christmas (Bradley Joseph album) Classic Christmas is the 15th studio album by Bradley Joseph released in 2008 on the Robbins Island Music label. While discussing, "Classic Christmas", Gerry Grzyb, chairman of the University of Wisconsin–Oshkosh sociology department, states that Joseph's usual approach is to play the carol straight, and then add his own twists. "he's very effective at that—he doesn't stray as far as a jazz or classical organ improviser might, but he does keep the interest up."
